To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a novel Geometric Passivity based control design for 4-DOFs underactuated overhead cranes.
we have proposed a Geometric PBC based control law for 4-DOFs overhead crane systems which is capable of precise payload positioning.
we have successfully applied Geometric PBC methodology to 4DOF overhead crane for stabilisation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of nonlinear control law for the 4-DOFs overhead crane system.
the development of nonlinear control law for the 4-DOFs underactuated overhead cranes.
the design of stabilising feedback control laws for underactuated systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed Geometric-PBC methodology is a powerful tool to solve control problems of underactuated mechanical systems with complex dynamics.
the proposed nonlinear control law is able to control the 4-DOFs of the underactuated overhead cranes system with precise positioning of the payload.
the proposed nonlinear control law has achieved the control objective of payload positioning and elimination of payload swings with the use of a simple control input force.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Geometric-PBC methodology is a powerful tool for synthesis of nonlinear feedback control laws for underactuated systems.
we are the first to design a stabilising nonlinear control law for 4-DOFs underactuated crane system.
the Geometric-PBC based control law is synthesised for 4-DOf overhead crane system and the results are compared with the 3-DOF system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the geometric-PBC approach can be used to control the underactuated systems with more than one un-actuated DOF.
the proposed control law is robust to parameter uncertainties and can be easily implemented on the physical system.
the proposed methodology is applicable to a class of underactuated systems with multiple DOF and multiple inputs.
